work.name: Conscious Cup
work.summary: Barista in a high-volume, community-focused specialty coffee shop.
highlights: Prepared single-origin espresso, milk drinks, pour-overs, and custom beverages during peak rush hours without sacrificing quality.
Textured and steamed milk to precise temperatures and consistencies for each drink standard, producing latte art and maintaining quality across high-volume service.
Operated and maintained coffee equipment including espresso machines, grinders, and brewers; dialed in grinders multiple times daily to ensure optimal extraction.
Hand-crafted house-made syrups, chai concentrate, and cold brew concentrate in precise batches daily to support high-volume beverage production and ensure consistent flavor quality.
Followed precise drink recipes and preparation standards to consistently craft high-quality beverages that exceeded customer expectations.
Completed internal proficiency assessments in espresso calibration and milk texturing for each traditional drink offering.
Greeted customers warmly, built lasting relationships, and proactively recommended menu options to enhance their experience.
Recommended and served food items including sandwiches and pastries; handled POS transactions and cash with accuracy.
Restocked supplies such as cups, lids, coffee beans, syrups, and pastries; monitored expiration dates to ensure freshness and food safety.
Maintained cleanliness of equipment, countertops, and café seating areas; assisted with opening and closing duties including setup, cleaning, and inventory tasks.

work.name: The Lucky Monk
work.summary: Server at a fast-paced casual dining restaurant/micro-brewery.
highlights: Managed multiple tables and coordinated with kitchen and bar staff for timely service.
Processed payments and balanced daily receipts with zero discrepancies.
Communicated customer allergy information to kitchen staff and front-of-house management to ensure health and safety compliance.

work.name: Northern Trust

Drove adoption of Agile methodology through story creation, sprint refinement, and iterative delivery.

Mentored junior team members through reviews, technical guidance, and documented troubleshooting strategies.
